name: phone-signalwire
description: Press Call me and a bot rings your phone through SignalWire, and you talk with it, hands-free. Its own model, memory, and tools answer, and nothing reaches fxbot.

settings.name: space
settings.description: Your SignalWire space, such as example.signalwire.com

settings.name: token
settings.description: An API token of the space with the Voice scope

settings.name: from
settings.description: Your SignalWire number calls come from, such as +15551234567

settings.name: to
settings.description: Your phone, the only number bots call, such as +15557654321

settings.name: voice
settings.description: A SignalWire voice, as engine.voice:model: Polly Neural is the cheapest, ElevenLabs and Cartesia cost about three times as much

settings.name: quiet
settings.description: Hours a bot doesn't call on its own, in your time zone

settings.name: perDay
settings.description: The most calls one bot makes on its own in a day, 1 to 20
